source.mesh and doping: identical to the DEVSIM case, node for node
source.impact ionisation: generation term in the equations, Selberherr form; electron coefficients as in the ionisation integral, hole coefficients of the low-field branch only
source.carrier lifetime: 1e-9 s in Charon, 1e-5 s in DEVSIM
source.doping of the die sections: the first doping family, before the refit to the deep N-well; the comparison is of the method, not of the present predictions
source.peak silicon field, Charon over DEVSIM: 0.9985 to 0.9988 on the bare N-well edge; 1.5 % to 2.5 % lower on the die sections, 0.1 % lower on the deep N-well; not explained
source.corner sections: none: Charon has no axisymmetric option
source.pending: the corrected polysilicon-plate section, NP4 under BL
